description: This file defines a PHP interface named AuthParamsInterface within the OrangeHRM\Authentication\Dto namespace. The interface declares two methods for retrieving authentication parameters: getCredential() and getAttributeBag(), which return instances of UserCredentialInterface and AuthAttributeBagInterface, respectively. The file includes licensing and description comments relevant to the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: AuthParamsInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying methods to access user credentials and authentication attribute data within the authentication DTO context.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns an object implementing UserCredentialInterface or null.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns an object implementing AuthAttributeBagInterface or null.
